contentText: You can strike Jensen Huang from the guest list but good luck steering dinner conversation away from the topic in Shenzhen. The co-founder of the AI computing leader was to accompany the US president to the APEC summit before he was undone by revelations of a dalliance with a Chinese national that happened to coincide with a Singapore client's backdoor skirting of sanctions on its powerful H200 chips.
